arm1x_tier_endpoint_role_distinction.external_control_pairwise_two_sample_se_: Note on contrast topology (AUDIT-REF & AUDIT-REF): because sigma_run(r)^2 = (64 + 49/2)/r = 88.5 / r already divides by the within-cell clone count r, SE(2*beta_j) = sqrt(88.5 / (2*r)) = 3.8406 pp at r = 3 (df = 16, 23.18% power) or 1.7176 pp at r = 15 (df = 112, 82.28% power) applies to each orthogonal 4-cell vs 4-cell main/interaction contrast within the 2^3 factorial, whereas pairwise two-sample comparisons between a single factorial cell (r_cell clones) and an external reference arm (r_ctrl clones of unmodified 3,974-bp Arm 1B or canonical 15-aa L1) have SE_pairwise = sqrt(sigma_run(r_cell)^2 + sigma_run(r_ctrl)^2) = sqrt(88.5 * (1/r_cell + 1/r_ctrl)): at r_cell = r_ctrl = 3, SE_pairwise = sqrt(88.5 * 2/3) = 7.6811 pp (two-sample t df = 4, power = 8.04% for 5.0 pp); at r_cell = 15 with r_ctrl = 3, SE_pairwise = sqrt(88.5 * (1/15 + 1/3)) = 5.9498 pp (df = 16, power = 12.41%); and if the external reference arm is co-expanded to r_ctrl = 15 alongside r_cell = 15, SE_pairwise = sqrt(88.5 * 2/15) = 3.4351 pp (df = 28, exact noncentral-t power = 29.01% [0.290119; 29.07% is an earlier approximation]; AUDIT-REF).
